My words look maybe look like simple compliments but I suggest you to try to realize what I said is true,even because through words you will not smell and taste the food there ,really no need explain but better 'try' and later I would like to know of you will agree with what I said.
Bye bye and enjoy Vietnam amazimg wounderful country and for sure Hanoi with its best Indian restaurant SPICE...happy lunch or dinner !

Great Host, Great Food
Mar 2014 • Couples
This restaurant was very near our Hotel so we passed it every time we went in and out so it was very convenient to pop in...........was surprised by the really good food on offer at very reasonable prices...their claypot meals were so good.
It's not a large place but very relaxing, with lovely soft seating and cushions in abundance.
1 thing I did notice too was that a lot of people popped in for a snack and to use the wifi.....there were sockets at every table, never seen that before.
A great host, and there are a couple of tables outside too for anyone who wants a ciggy.
Good luck from 2 very satisfied customers in UK

Special place!
Feb 2014
This restaurant caught my attention walking back to hotel one night... I went there for dinner and i had very good time.
Small place- about 6/8 tables maybe- with a quiet and relaxed family atmosphere. 
Wi-fii is free. Perfect for young travellers, they have special offers for cocktail time. 
Service is very good and quick enough. 
Staff smiling and helpfull.
I had dinner quite late (about 10/10:30 pm) 
Most important at least: Delicious Curry! You have to try it!
